info.title: Lore API
info.description: Generated from the lore-api hapi route zod schemas (ADR-035). This document describes request contracts and the uniform `{ error }` error envelope precisely; success response bodies are not declaratively described and appear generically. Per-route required scope is the `x-required-scope` extension (HTTP bearer has no scope list); the rate-limit bucket is `x-rate-limit-bucket`.
